title: Review of c04's clipped-crawler sweep (negative): 3 of the 7 settings on fresh seed 2 give the same outcomes (max generation 2 or 0, boom-bust to extinction, merged churn)
summary: Re-ran three settings of the sweep with the finding's world (bV=1, okclip=1) on fresh seed 2, T=600. shed 0.2: 2-3 crawlers that move up to 8.6 BL, 2 persistent splits, max generation 2 (as on seed 1). kup 0.06, shed 0.1: the founder's progeny merge into a domain-filling sea by t~130, which breaks into ~19 cells at t~240-360 that then starve one by one; extinct by t~575 (seed 1 kept 3 static cells). kup 0.05, shed 0.25, rn 0.006: 40 splits and 29 merges, 0 persistent splits, a large body at occupancy 0.33. No setting gives sustained crawling division.

observations.D: summary.txt: max generation 2 / 2 / 0, persistent splits 2 / 8 / 0 across the three settings on seed 2; rerun/ocsk/seed2/sheet.png boom to a merged sea, break-up, starvation to extinction by t~575

controls_run.D: the three sweep points themselves, seed 2

verdicts.limitation: 3 of 7 points, one fresh seed. Like the author, I did not try starting food at the regrowth-limited level, which looks like the obvious next test: the boom is driven by the initial n0=1 stock.
